title: Autophagy: Cellular Recycling, Survival and Homeostasis
method: Whitespace-delimited visible teaching paragraphs before Part B; excludes headings, tables, figures/captions, questions, references, UI. Article includes captions, headings, tables, practice and references, excludes SVG and zoom buttons.
comparator: 2.D.08 independently counted 8439 narrative words; 2.D.09 QA reports 7579; 2.D.05 QA reports 7361. Autophagy has 14 theory sections with mechanistic treatment, experimental inference and quantitative practice, scoped to the approved roadmap.
scientific_checks: Official merged NET Unit 2.D p.3 and archived MP SET 2024 p.2 visually verified. Reviewed yeast trapping and genetic screen, macro/micro/CMA, ULK–AMPK–mTORC1, PI3P, two ATG conjugation systems, membrane topology, SNARE fusion, PINK1/Parkin and NIX, physiological evidence, autophagy-dependent death criteria, LC3/p62 and tandem reporter limits, stock/flow and inhibitor-sensitive turnover. First self-review expanded neonatal, NIX and SNARE evidence and assay controls; second self-review refined route terminology, MCQ format, regulation and arithmetic. Synthetic data and original questions/figures. Numerical checks: 12,24,24,23,13,2,40%,10%,7.5; practice 24,48,2,0.5,1/6,2h,6h,19,36,9,25 percentage points.
limitations: Two substantive editorial self-review passes, not external human review. Static source/diagram geometry and arithmetic checks; no interactive browser/device or full accessibility audit. MP SET source is archived, not a current original MPPSC-hosted syllabus. Live Pages verification separate and pending at commit.
